test-data-integrity.mjs gained section 12b: every theme in use has its shopColor, latinColor and descColor checked against its own paperGradEnd at the same 4.5:1 bar the herb accent already met. Those three come from the theme rather than the herb, so one bad value is wrong on every label at once, which is worse than one herb reading poorly. Proved by making one bad on purpose: a lightened latinColor failed at 1.14:1 and the suite exited 1, and the file was restored and the suite passes.

src/main.js reads var(--warn) for the boot-failure screen instead of the #C4580A literal, which is exactly what --warn holds in styles/base.css. Two copies of one colour drift the day the token moves, and this is the screen nobody looks at until it matters.

The file-layout table in CLAUDE.md carries a row for every source file again. Five were missing, not the four the finding named: escape-html.js, resolve-illustration.js, saved-labels.js, suggest.js and truncate.js. Each description is read off the header the file already carried about itself rather than guessed, and a walk over src/ now finds no .js file without a row. Committed from the index rather than the working tree, so the uncommitted convention edit another session left in that file stayed theirs.

Every herb record drops the clinical register, 37 rewrites across four fields, and a gate in test-data-integrity.mjs refuses the twenty words the file actually carried. A source could not be added honestly: the text was written as flavour copy for a label designer rather than from a reference, and inventing a citation would be worse than the sentence it dressed up. So the finding's other half is the one taken, and what a plant is said to do stays while the drug class, the receptor and the mechanism go. Another session had started the same work on the compounds field and stopped, which is why its edits were sitting uncommitted; this finished the sweep across cautions, historicUses, desc and descFull as well. A scan for the register returns zero, and all five suites pass.
REDACTED: this text named a weakness and the file it lives in, which together are an address. Severity and project are kept; the location is in the project's own report under X:\PortfolioOps.
